svg.text: the limit 1/3 = Var/mean² of the roots
the lowest edge: t = 1, sinking towards 1/3
the middle of the row rises to 0.63 and stays there
left to right: the coefficient index, from the first one to the middle of the row
into the page: the size n, doubling each step from 5 to 513
Newton's inequality has a floor, and for the Stirling numbers it is 1/3
M(n,t) = n (p_t² / p_{t-1}p_{t+1} − 1) for the spectrum 1, 2, ..., n-1 (Stirling numbers of the first kind); every value shown is exact arithmetic
